# equinix_fabric_asn (Resource)

Fabric V4 API compatible resource allows creation and management of Equinix Fabric Autonomous System Numbers (ASNs).

A PRIVATE_ASN is provisioned by Equinix in the given metro and range. A PUBLIC_ASN is registered by number and RIR region and stays in the PENDING state until the signed ownership challenge is provided in `ownership_challenge_details.signature`.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/ASNs



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (Attributes) Project this ASN belongs to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--project))
- `type` (String) ASN type. One of: PUBLIC_ASN, PRIVATE_ASN

### Optional

- `location` (Attributes) Location of a PRIVATE_ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `number` (Number) Autonomous System Number. Required for a PUBLIC_ASN; assigned by Equinix for a PRIVATE_ASN
- `ownership_challenge_details` (Attributes) Ownership challenge of a PUBLIC_ASN. Sign the returned message and set the signature to complete the verification (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ownership_challenge_details))
- `range` (String) Range of a PRIVATE_ASN. One of: 16_BIT, 32_BIT
- `rir_region` (String) Regional Internet Registry region of a PUBLIC_ASN. One of: AFRINIC, APNIC, ARIN, LACNIC, RIPE_NCC
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `assets` (Attributes List) Assets (services) the ASN is attached to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Details of the last change on the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change_log))
- `href` (String) URL of the ASN resource
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource
- `state` (String) State of the ASN. One of: REQUESTED, PROVISIONING, PENDING, PROVISIONED, ATTACHED, FAILED, PROVISIONING_FAILED, DEPROVISIONING, DEPROVISIONING_FAILED, DEPROVISIONED
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned UUID of the ASN

<a id="nestedatt--ownership_challenge_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ownership_challenge_details`

Required:

- `type` (String) Ownership challenge type. One of: RPKI, LOA

Optional:

Read-Only:

- `message` (String) Challenge message to sign

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
